outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured time-lapse microscopy images of a photoactivation experiment with no quantification or statistics; representative image panels do not require replicate reporting.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A) (red: euchromatin, green: heterochromatin).
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
outputs.explanation: Panel B presents quantified intensity curves with model fits and explicitly averaged data (insets show 'average early time points responses'), indicating replicated measurements, but neither the number of replicates (e.g., cells, experiments, or ROIs averaged) nor the type of replicate is stated anywhere in the caption.
